sloka: वानराश्च स्विकां योनिमृक्षाश्चैव तथा ययुः ।येभ्यो विनिस्सृताः सर्वे सुरेभ्यः सुरसम्भवाः ।। ७.११०.२१ ॥
transliteration: vānarāśca svikāṁ yonimṛkṣāścaiva tathā yayuḥ ।yebhyo vinissṛtāḥ sarve surebhyaḥ surasambhavāḥ ।। 7.110.21 ॥

translations.english: The monkeys and bears, who were all born of gods and had originated from them, returned to their respective divine forms.
